My goal is to maximize my own net gain (settled reimbursement minus my receipt cost). When reviewing A's claim, I should approve the minimum possible amount (0 units), minimizing their payout and maximizing my comparative advantage. While this is adversarial and may result in mutual minimization if A adopts the same strategy, the instructions are to maximize my own score individually, so mutual retaliation is not my concern for this experiment.
